name: sense_cone_outside
about: Outside the cone at sight distance a hostile Troika human sees nothing. Same guard as sense_cone_enter (behind_cover (156, 0) Source units facing -X, D_HT 5, npc_perception 3 -> 440 units); the standing player stands in the open at (220, -295), 302 units from the eye -- inside 440 and inside 0.7 x 440, unoccluded -- but off to the side: from the cone apex 40 units behind the eye (debug_viewcone_back_dist 40, FinViewCone3dNew 0x103264d0) the normalized dot against the facing is -0.08, below m_flFieldOfView 0.2 (0x10298d30; the target cone scalar is 1.0 for a standing player). Look's per-candidate test (0x1030ffa0) refuses him at FInViewCone slot 363 (0x102b4540 -> 0x10326750), so OnLooked 0x1026a2c0 raises nothing, no enemy is committed and the NPC stays idle. SetPlayerLOS 0x10291610 (no cone term, 'in PVS within 512 -> LOS true') is a think-cadence input, not a sighting (stealth.md 'Closest-player cone and LOS cache').
